item.title: Kubernetes Homelab
item.description:
Built a self-managed Kubernetes cluster to experiment with infrastructure patterns.

Highlights

  • GitOps deployment using FluxCD
  • Helm-based application management
  • Repeatable cluster rebuilds
  • Adding Monitoring Dashboards

Why

To simulate real-world infrastructure in a controlled environment and experiment safely.
